where: README install section, Cargo package metadata
sandbox: fresh clone with only a supported newer Rust installed; the test provisions Rust 1.88 when absent, then runs a locked build

claim: The production build creates dist/site/index.html and the Rust release executable
sandbox: fresh clone; run the production build and assert the static entry point and release executable exist

claim: Direct loads preserve /demo, /privacy, and /terms; unknown URLs return the designed page with HTTP 404
sandbox: fresh production build served with the shipped Static Web Apps routing rules; load each route directly and verify the status and page

claim: The CLI and browser demos use the request, response, and secret-removal fields shipped in examples
sandbox: fresh CLI and browser demos; compare their event, method, path, response status, and removed fields with both shipped example files

claim: The default CLI demo creates a temporary folder, prints a working local mock command, and the landing shows that output
where: README sample demo section, landing CLI transcript
sandbox: run boundary-replay demo without --out; compare normalized stdout with both landing transcripts, start the printed local mock command, verify the recorded fixture, then remove the temporary folder

claim: Removes selected headers and JSON fields before saving
sandbox: fresh temp folder and loopback service; record one HTTP request; inspect the saved request and response for redaction markers and absence of secrets

claim: Mock servers and webhook sends accept loopback addresses only
sandbox: run the CLI against a non-loopback bind and target; then send every standard redirect status from one loopback service to another; assert no recorded or signed webhook traffic reaches the redirected destination

claim: An exported mock matches its recorded method and path and returns the recorded status, headers, and body on loopback
sandbox: fresh CLI demo export; start the mock on loopback; POST to the recorded path; assert status 503, content-type and retry-after headers, and the recorded JSON body

claim: A webhook with selected secrets removed is re-signed before it is sent
sandbox: fresh CLI demo bundle and local receiver; send with a test environment secret; assert a fresh HMAC signature and no captured signature

claim: The browser demo uses sample data, stores only demo-prefixed session state, and makes no third-party request
sandbox: fresh browser context with real-data sentinels; record requests and storage while opening, inspecting, exporting, resetting, and leaving /demo

claim: The CLI demo never reads or changes an existing capture folder
sandbox: create an existing captures/payment-webhook.json with private content; run demo --out against its parent; assert the command refuses and the file is byte-for-byte unchanged

claim: Boundary Replay sends no telemetry during its local demo flow
sandbox: fresh browser context records all requests while visiting the landing page and demo; run the shipped CLI demo under a connect-denying preload guard; assert browser requests remain same-origin, the CLI succeeds, and it makes no socket connection

claim: Recorded requests and exported mocks are written only under the output folders you name
sandbox: fresh temp folder and local upstream; capture into a named folder, export into a second named folder, and assert no sibling files were created

claim: Export and demo accept only a new or empty output folder
sandbox: fresh demo captures and a populated output folder containing private-looking JSON; assert both demo and export fail before any file changes

claim: Demo, export, and send support JSON output; CLI errors use stderr and a non-zero exit code
sandbox: fresh demo bundle; parse demo and export JSON results, then use a non-loopback send target and assert empty stdout, actionable stderr, and failure status

claim: Recording begins only after you run the capture command
sandbox: fresh loopback port and local service; prove no server responds before launch, then run the capture command and assert a request is recorded

claim: The browser demo works offline after the first visit
sandbox: fresh browser context; visit /demo; wait for service worker control; go offline; reload and inspect the fixture

claim: The browser demo exports one sample with selected secrets removed
sandbox: fresh browser context; download the demo bundle; assert its manifest, count, status, and redaction markers

claim: The local exporter is free to use
sandbox: fresh browser context; open the demo, export its bundle, and inspect the downloaded fixture
